scoreSelection.note: One reproducible model-weighted scenario, not the modal exact-score estimate.

outlook.note: Model-weighted uncertainty, not guaranteed outcomes or a forced surprise.

analysis.modelNote: Reliability-weighted goal/venue history; opposition adjustment, rest and margin-normalized market use the existing validated pipeline. Unavailable signals excluded.

uncertainty.note: A reproducible model-weighted scenario; the modal exact score and broader outcome probabilities are separate statistics.

appearance.note: Monocular landmark ratios mapped to bounded stylised morphs; not a face scan. Hair and beard retain reviewed profiles where present.
appearance.hairEstimate: coarse photo colour/coverage estimate; not manually verified
